title: Matched paper-lattice public-decoder transfer pilot

program_alignment.central_question: Does physically available D4 fusion information remain useful beyond the exact primitive fixture, and is the published public decoder able to convert that information into lower logical risk?
program_alignment.work_package: WP2 intrinsic information to scalable-decoder bridge; Lab 004 R5 bounded reproduction pilot
program_alignment.rationale: R4.5c established exact fusion-information value but localized most primitive public O2 excess to the first herald-weight action. A matched paper-normalized public-decoder pilot is the cheapest test of whether either observation survives beyond the primitive channel. It is also the prerequisite for choosing a D4 inner decoder for Lab 005; the source-matched D(S3) schedule branch in Lab 005 can continue independently.

question_and_hypotheses.question: On paper-normalized periodic D4 honeycomb lattices at L=2 and L=3, how do syndrome-only O0 MWPM and published heralded O2 MWPM compare on the same initial physical/fusion histories near the source-reported transition window?
question_and_hypotheses.h_information_transfer: The heralded public policy has lower logical failure probability than syndrome-only decoding in at least part of the registered window, with a direction that does not reverse between L=2 and L=3.
question_and_hypotheses.h_primitive_gap_persists: The heralded policy's first-stage logical-failure contribution remains large enough that its realized advantage is materially smaller than the primitive exact O2 information advantage.
question_and_hypotheses.null_or_negative: The public heralded policy ties or underperforms syndrome-only decoding, or its apparent advantage reverses with size; this weakens transfer of the published heuristic but does not negate R4.5c's exact primitive information result.
question_and_hypotheses.unresolved_outcome: Intervals are too wide or decoder failures/censoring exceed their gates; report the pilot as unresolved and do not add samples without a new registration.

external: Jing et al. (2025) report syndrome-only and intrinsically heralded D4 thresholds near 0.15860 and 0.20842 under their fixed-point channel; these values motivate the pilot window but are not project results.
Jing et al. (2026) motivates constrained optimization as a reference for general fusion rules but does not replace the 2025 public D4 PyMatching decoder.
project: R0 verifies the paper normalization 6L^2 vertices, 9L^2 red edges, and K=27L^2.
R2 verifies both public decoder stages and their objectives on bounded matched records.
R4.5c establishes exact primitive O2 information gain and a first-action-dominated public-policy gap.
source_basis.claim_boundary: This pilot may report finite-size public-decoder logical risks and paired differences only. It cannot estimate a threshold, an asymptotic phase boundary, an exact larger-lattice Bayes risk, a noisy-measurement result, or a fault-tolerance claim.

design.matching: For every (L,p,seed), both public policies share the same physical error and initial fusion record. The policy-dependent second measurement is generated from the corresponding post-flux state with a deterministic seed stream; comparisons are paired by complete seed trajectory without pretending the second observations are identical.
design.seed_rule: SeedSequence([222973953,L,round(10000p),seed]) for the physical draw and a separately derived decoder stream; integer seed is 0..1999 and no seed may be selected after outcomes are inspected.
recorded_outcomes: wall time by policy and stage

primary_estimands: paired heralded-minus-syndrome-only logical-risk difference for each (L,p)
stage-resolved failure fractions within each policy
L=3 minus L=2 risk change for each fixed p and policy
analysis.uncertainty: Two-sided 90% Wilson intervals for each binomial risk and a two-sided 90% seed-cluster bootstrap interval for each paired policy difference and size difference. Resampling unit is the complete seeded trajectory; 10000 deterministic bootstrap replicates.
analysis.decision_rule: Call a directional public-policy advantage at a cell only when the paired 90% interval for heralded-minus-syndrome-only risk excludes zero. Otherwise retain the numerical difference and label the cell unresolved. Do not fit or report a crossing or threshold.
analysis.sensitivity: Repeat paired-difference summaries after separating terminal physical windings from decoder-contingent failures. Any conclusion that changes sign is reported as mechanism-dependent rather than robust.
analysis.no_interpretive_mapping: The output is a finite-size risk table/curve with uncertainty and stage decomposition, not a categorical phase map.

required_gates: paper-normalized vertex, edge, degree, period-rank, and K=3E invariants pass at both sizes
same (L,p,seed) produces identical physical error and initial fusion record in both public policies
every nonterminal public correction is syndrome faithful and every post-flux record satisfies its generated support constraints
stage statuses are exhaustive and mutually exclusive
no decoder exception, invalid support, future observation, or truth field enters a policy decision
projected production wall time is at most 30 minutes and projected resident memory is at most 4 GiB
preflight.stop_rule: Stop before production on any scientific, observation-boundary, source-stability, topology, support, syndrome-fidelity, status-accounting, wall-time, or memory failure. Preserve the failing witness.

production_activation.execution_rule: Run exactly the registered 20000 histories and 40000 public decoder evaluations, then run the frozen analyzer. Stop on any source-hash, pipeline-invariant, paired-record, count, output-integrity, wall-time, or memory failure.
production_activation.claim_rule: Report only finite-size public-policy risks, paired differences, size changes, and stage decomposition with the registered 90% intervals.

analysis_amendment.trigger: Pre-promotion completeness review found that the first analyzer emitted policy differences but omitted the registered size-difference estimand and terminal-winding sensitivity.
analysis_amendment.correction: Add L=3 minus L=2 risk differences using independent complete-trajectory bootstrap resampling within each size, because physical seed streams are intentionally size-specific; also report the paired policy difference after excluding shared terminal physical-winding histories.
analysis_amendment.affected_artifacts: The raw 40000-record production cohort is unchanged and remains valid. The first analysis JSON is overwritten before promotion; no scientific claim used it.
analysis_amendment.selection_boundary: The correction follows the preregistered estimands and sampling independence, not observed effect direction. No grid, sample, confidence level, decision threshold, or claim boundary changes.

production_result.retention_note: The original gzip SHA-256 remains recorded for provenance; trajectories were removed after exact reconciliation to cell, stage, batch, and paired-policy counts.
production_result.validation: gzip stream readable; exactly 40000 records, 20 policy cells, 10 paired policy differences, and 10 independent size differences; no adaptive sampling or threshold fit

next_action: Register the validated D4 public spatial-policy interface consumed by Lab 005, preserving Lab 005 causal/noisy observation boundaries; keep the R6 matched belief-decoder comparison as a separate scalable-algorithm branch.
